summary: Damage and heal numbers popping over a world point, pooled, with style presets.
overview: The classic RPG hit feedback: numbers pop over a world hit point, drift and fade. A singleton like the fade and transition managers, with presets so damage, heal, miss and status each have a consistent look you configure once.
useCases: Damage and healing numbers in combat.
Status effect notifications over a character.

params.tuning: Random scatter so simultaneous hits do not stack into an unreadable pile. This is the setting that makes rapid combat legible.
Used to convert the world point to screen space. Defaults to the main camera, which breaks quietly with more than one.
Where the look is defined per kind. Adding a new kind is a preset, not new code.

gotchas.title: It pools, so the prefab must be poolable
gotchas.body: A custom prefab needs the matching component so it can hand itself back. Without it, instances accumulate.
